variants.name: zero_shot_final_answer
variants.prompt_suffix: Return only the final numeric answer with its unit. Do not explain the calculation.

variants.name: structured_json
variants.prompt_suffix: Return exactly one JSON object and no other text. Use this schema: {"evidence":["table field and year"],"formula":"numeric arithmetic formula","value":0,"unit":"million|percent|dollars|shares|"}. Preserve the table column, row, year, and unit in evidence. The value must be the final answer.

variants.name: structured_json_compact
variants.prompt_suffix: Return exactly one JSON object, no markdown and no explanation. Use only these keys: evidence, formula, value, unit. evidence must be a one-element array containing one short string naming the exact table row, column, and year. formula must contain only numeric arithmetic with +, -, *, /, and parentheses. value must be the final numeric answer. unit must be one of million, percent, dollars, shares, or empty string.

variants.name: few_shot_structured_json
variants.prompt_suffix: Use the provided training examples as format guidance only. Return exactly one JSON object with evidence, formula, value, and unit; do not include any other text.

variants.name: structured_json_calculator
variants.prompt_suffix: Return exactly one JSON object with evidence, formula, value, and unit. Write formula using only numeric arithmetic (+, -, *, /, parentheses). The formula will be checked by a deterministic calculator; do not put prose or years into the formula.
